subject: Issue with terraclimate climate change calculation in micro_era5 and micro_ncep

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Issue with terraclimate climate change calculation in micro_era5 and micro_ncep
parts:
Hi everyone,
There was a problem in the call to the 'get_terra' function implementation in micro_era5 and micro_ncep, in that the location was not being passed. Thus it was always extracting from the default location. The problem is now fixed on github. Sorry if you've been using this new functionality already and thanks Liang Ma for spotting the problem.
All the best,
Mike
